title: Referral System Action Reference: Extension Visits on Visit Referrals
content:
When a visit referral whose type adds units on extension — the In-Group Specialist Referral, the HMO Specialist Referral, the Out-of-Network Referral and the Physical Therapy Episode Authorization under Referrals & Prior Authorizations — is extended, the extension visits are posted as a unit grant with the reason extension, and the extension is recorded as one extension decision. An extension grant may be posted on an exhausted referral, which returns to approved with that grant.

## Rule

Extension visits on an out-of-network referral are not posted until a cost-share acknowledgement signed by the patient within the past month stands on the referral.

The extension visits are fixed only after the referral's valid-through date lies at least the tier's extension validity days beyond the handling date.

Restated: an Out-of-Network Referral that carries no cost-share acknowledgement signed by the patient within the past month has no extension visits posted; and for every one of these types the number of extension visits is settled only once, on the handling date, the valid-through date shown on the referral is at least the type's extension validity days away.

## What the action does

One call books a unit grant with the reason extension, dated today, for the number of visits given; raises the referral's units remaining by that number; returns an exhausted referral to approved (an approved one stays approved); adds one to the count of extensions granted; and marks the latest decision as an extension dated today. The validity dates and the provider are left unchanged. The patient can then see the added visits on the referral and the grant in its unit history.

## How it is invoked

The action is `grant_extension_visits_d2c34b29`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `referral_id` | the reference number of the visit referral, as shown on the referral returned by the referral lookup for this patient | identifier, as shown |
| `extension_visits` | the number of visits the extension adds; one unit is one visit | a whole number greater than zero, no fraction |

## Return

A successful call returns `grant_id` (the reference of the unit grant booked), `referral_id` (the referral), `units_granted` (the visits added), `units_remaining` (the visits now covered), `status` (approved) and `extension_count` (extensions granted so far, including this one). A returned `grant_id` means success.
